manifest.name: Dominoes
manifest.description: Double-six dominoes, settled on chain. Both hands are dealt through a mutual mental-poker shuffle so neither player controls or knows the deal.
manifest.icon: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 64 64' role='img' aria-label='Dominoes'><defs><linearGradient id='d' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'><stop offset='0' stop-color='#3a2a1c'/><stop offset='1' stop-color='#17110c'/></linearGradient><linearGradient id='t' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'><stop offset='0' stop-color='#f6ead2'/><stop offset='1' stop-color='#dcc7a2'/></linearGradient></defs><rect width='64' height='64' rx='14' fill='url(#d)'/><rect x='2.5' y='2.5' width='59' height='59' rx='11.5' fill='none' stroke='#ffc17a' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.45'/><g transform='rotate(-8 32 32)'><rect x='20' y='10' width='24' height='44' rx='4' fill='url(#t)'/><path d='M21.5 32h21' stroke='#8a7355' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/><g fill='#241a12'><circle cx='26.5' cy='16.5' r='2.5'/><circle cx='32' cy='21' r='2.5'/><circle cx='37.5' cy='25.5' r='2.5'/><circle cx='26.5' cy='39' r='2.5'/><circle cx='37.5' cy='47.5' r='2.5'/></g></g></svg>
manifest.instructions: You and your opponent each get 7 tiles from a 28-tile double-six set, dealt through a mutual mental-poker shuffle so neither side knows or controls the deal. The other 14 tiles form the boneyard. On your turn, play a tile matching either open end of the line. The opener must lead their highest double if they hold one. If you cannot play, draw from the boneyard until you can, or until it runs out and you pass. First to empty their hand wins. If both players pass with the boneyard empty the game is blocked, and the lower pip total wins.

manifest.name: Chesstlan
manifest.description: Full FIDE chess settled on chain. A commit-reveal coin toss decides colours — neither player can steer it — and every move is validated by the contract itself: castling rights, en passant, promotion, check, mate, stalemate, the fifty-move and seventy-five-move clocks, and threefold repetition. An illegal move is not rejected, it is punished.
manifest.instructions: A coin toss decides who plays White. White opens; play alternates until the game ends. Every rule is enforced on chain, so an illegal move costs the sender the pot rather than being politely refused. Beyond winning by checkmate you can claim a draw once the fifty-move clock or a threefold repetition allows it, and you may resign at any point — including your very first move — which pays the pot to your opponent. Stalemate, dead position and the seventy-five-move rule end the game in a draw automatically and split the pot.

manifest.name: Texas Hold'em
manifest.description: Heads-up Texas Hold'em with a provably fair deal — cards are shuffled and dealt cryptographically, so neither player can see or influence any card. Bet across four streets: preflop, flop, turn, river. Check, call, raise or fold. Best five-card hand wins at showdown, or take the pot if they fold.

manifest.instructions: You are dealt two private hole cards, provably fair via mental poker. Bet across four streets — preflop, flop, turn and river — choosing check, call, raise, or fold to concede the pot and keep your cards secret. The flop (3), turn (1) and river (1) community cards are revealed between rounds. Make the best five-card hand from your two holes and the five shared cards to win the pot at showdown.

manifest.description: Wordle-style game. Each player picks a word for the opponent to guess. First to guess wins, tie if both guess on same turn.
